verdict.rationale: Foreloop exposes CLI (with --json on every command) and an MCP endpoint that lets agents claim tasks, open PRs, and manage projects/loops/intentions/tasks, suggesting broad API/CLI parity with the UI. However, some workflows (e.g., approving contracts 'from your phone', reviewing agent status dashboards) appear UI-centric, and there's no explicit confirmation that every UI action (like approvals or feedback triage) is fully scriptable via API/CLI.
